scope: Intersection POS×OSS — cascade integrity POS PREPARED → outbox → broadcast → OSS render

cascade_trace.what: changeStatus() locks order, sets status=8 (PREPARED), recordTransition, then post-commit dispatches OrderStatusChanged via DispatchableAfterCommit
Event deferred until DB tx commits — rollback drops event entirely (gate C9 / KI-001)

Idempotency key = sha1(eventType|orderId|oldStatus|newStatus|correlationId); firstOrCreate(domain_events); afterCommit → DispatchDomainEventsJob.dispatch (try/catch best-effort, log warn on broadcast failure)
Broadcast channel is branch-scoped private channel; payload exposes order_id, queue_number, _origin, payment_method, payment_status, old_status, new_status, token
Vue subscribeEcho() requires branchId>0 (operator session). Handler: data.new_status==PREPARED -> _markNewReady(order_id) -> _playReadySound() + flash; then list() refresh.
Polled poll path re-detects PREPARED transitions via prevPreparedIds diff; _echoMarkedReady set dedupes against Echo path to prevent double chime.
Read query: whereIn(order_type,[KIOSK,TAKEAWAY]) + whereIn(status,[PREPARING,PREPARED]) + Paris→UTC day bounds + stale prune (now('UTC') - 8h) + branch filter + FIFO order

state_machine_alignment_with_kds.kds_consumes: OrderStatus::PREPARING (orange column) and OrderStatus::PREPARED (green column) — same enum constants used by OSS read query line 63
state_machine_alignment_with_kds.transition_owner: OrderService::changeStatus dispatches a single OrderStatusChanged; KDS listener (DispatchKdsTicket) and OSS broadcast both flow through SAME event — SSOT respected.
state_machine_alignment_with_kds.ready_terminology: OSS calls PREPARED 'ready' in UI; backend enum PREPARED=8 is the only canonical 'ready' state. No drift detected.

findings.title: Cascade is end-to-end clean and atomic with the DB transaction.
evidence: app/Events/OrderStatusChanged.php:17 DispatchableAfterCommit ensures rollback drops the event
DispatchDomainEventsJob.dispatch wrapped in try/catch (line 73..85) — broadcast failure does NOT roll back the HTTP request (test-e2e fix E-001)

findings.title: Dual-path dedupe (Echo + poll) correctly prevents double chime.
evidence: public/js/admin-oss.js:420..423 pre-registers Echo'd PREPARED order_id into _echoMarkedReady before list() refresh
public/js/admin-oss.js:523..530 _hydrateFromRows skips _markNewReady if id is in echoMarked set, then clears one-shot guard
findings.rationale: Without this guard, an Echo event + poll refresh in the same second would fire the chime twice for the same order.

findings.title: OSS query reads PREPARING+PREPARED only — matches KDS surface contract.
evidence: Mirror line 200 listForBranch() — byte-identical query body per service docstring line 144

findings.title: Sister-of pattern between list() and listForBranch() prevents future drift.
evidence: Wave 3b/3c heals at lines 73..78 and 204..211 mirrored across both methods — TZ-aware day bounds, stale prune UTC, allowlist heal

findings.title: Three independent OrderStatusChanged dispatch sites identified — no orphan path bypasses the outbox.
findings.note: All three are POST-commit, all three feed PersistOrderStatusChangedToOutbox.handle() → same idempotency_key contract.

verdict: CASCADE INTEGRITY = INTACT. No architectural drift. POS→OSS contract honors the single domain-event SSOT pattern.
